scope: Root reviewed shared compareLines/textLines/lineCount, presentation, split alignment, main tool state labels and FileArtifactView diff against HEAD, final controlled browser and all eight pixels; independent final review also examined15files.
decisions: One bounded shared comparison, no new dependency, backend, protocol or Agent-specific logic.
Null original is distinguished from known empty, raw-side copies preserve exact strings, only aligned comparison yields exact counts and colored rows.
LF/CRLF/none retains separate old/new coordinates and whitespace bodies without trimming.
Diff path is opt-in existing file route; reported fragments stay separate from current file proof.
No change to actual Agent status, user data, official application, credentials or execution permissions.
limitations: Browsers run actual UI with synthetic messages and controlled IO, not native filesystem or installed UI.
Seventeen scenarios cover late inspection after owner switch; not late body read or close.
Whole P18 and unavailable real-Agent coverage remain open.
